title: DAILY FIGHTER — WEEK 2 DAY 11
emphasis: Sunday LOWER STRESS adjusted for AC-joint symptoms: aerobic base, stable bodyline practice, submaximal upper strength, posterior-chain and neck durability, elastic power mechanics, grip, and lower-leg armor

levels.bonus: Optional 5–10 min easy mobility. BJJ: Ignition + A×2/B×1/D×1 (19:30), or skip if class/time load is high.

ignition.name: Zone-2 Treadmill
ignition.cue: RPE 5; nasal breathing and unchanged posture

deposits.label: A
deposits.title: COMPRESSION + BODYLINE FOUNDATION
deposits.effort: Rest 1:00; RPE 6, 5 RIR. Core crunch establishes a floor-compression baseline; hollow hold deliberately repeats stable shape without progression. Knee-raise gate remains two clean 3×8 exposures ≤RPE 8 after symptoms permit.

exercises.name: Dopa Band Core Crunch
exercises.cue: Posterior pelvic tilt; exhale into compression

exercises.name: Hollow-Body Hold
exercises.cue: Low back down; ribs tucked; breathe

deposits.label: B
deposits.title: SUBMAXIMAL UPPER PATTERNING
deposits.effort: Rest 1:00; 5 RIR, RPE 5. Easy tension and pain-free range only; no overhead work, deep extension, or progression.

exercises.name: Dopa Band Seated Row
exercises.cue: Shoulders stay low; pull without radiating symptoms

exercises.name: Dopa Band Seated Chest Press
exercises.cue: Pain-free arc; ribs stacked; smooth return

deposits.label: C
deposits.title: POSTERIOR CHAIN + NECK ARMOR
deposits.effort: Rest 0:45; RPE 6, 5 RIR. Establish controlled durability baselines without load progression.

exercises.name: Dopa Band Hamstring Kickback
exercises.cue: Hips square; squeeze without lumbar extension

exercises.name: Self-Resisted Neck Isometrics
exercises.cue: Head stays still; gentle pressure; shoulders relaxed

deposits.label: D
deposits.title: ELASTIC POWER MECHANICS
deposits.effort: Rest 0:45; RPE 6. Deliberate quality repeat; stop when rhythm, height, landing, or posture declines.

exercises.name: Dopa Band Jump Ski Movement
exercises.cue: Elastic contacts; quiet landing; no fatigue chasing

deposits.label: E
deposits.title: GRIP + LOWER-LEG ARMOR
deposits.effort: Rest 0:20; RPE 6. Restore easy durability volume without increasing resistance.

exercises.name: Dopa Band Wrist Waves
exercises.cue: Wrists drive; elbows soft; shoulders relaxed

exercises.name: Tibialis Raise
exercises.cue: Heels planted; lift toes fully; controlled lower

martialSupplement.name: Dopa Band Technical Stand Up
martialSupplement.home: Dopa Band + mat: controlled technical stand-ups
martialSupplement.cue: Protect posture; posting hand only if symptom-free; solo work supplements coaching
